scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic proof is supplied; finite exact checks independently test key finite identities. No independent external audit or historical-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent rate-one edge arrival clocks on a finite one-dimensional path; the Poisson total-variation rate concerns late-arrival counts, while the spatial process converges weakly. The scalar Gumbel marginal is previously published and not asserted to be new. General RSA models and independent historical priority are outside the theorem.
title: Spatial Poisson limits for late dimer arrivals in Page–Rényi parking
